summary: Palace visual polish + regression tests. Discovered and fixed a CRITICAL CSS regression: all face-up playing cards were rendering at 2x24px (inline span with width ignored). Applied a one-line fix to .pc (display: inline-block). After the fix, Rummy palace, High Card felt, hand row, actions, and both regressions all pass.

ui_bugs.issue: Face-up cards rendered at 2x24 px because .pc is a <span> and had no `display:inline-block`. Inline elements ignore width/height. Symptom: 13 hand cards collapsed into a ~100px cluster on the tray, Discard & Wild piles unreadable, all face-up cards broken. FIXED by adding `display: inline-block; vertical-align: top;` to `.pc` in /app/frontend/src/pages/casino-vegas.css. Confirmed cards now render at declared 46x66 (md) and 38x54 (sm) with a clean 52px-pitch row across 13 cards.

Loaded /casino for player1 via localStorage → RummyTable rendered vegas-palace + vegas-host + 2 rummy-seat-* chips with PlayerAvatar rings and balance/cards pills (P1 shows 29,767 balance, P2 shows '13 cards' with 25s active-turn timer). Clicked rummy-start → Deal successful. 13 rcard-* buttons rendered in the hand tray (post-fix: 46x66 each, single row x=345->969). Piles rummy-draw-closed/open + Wild rendered. Draw closed pile + select first card + rummy-discard → succeeded (state moved to 14 cards then 13 after discard). rummy-declare, rummy-drop, rummy-fairness (Provably Fair commit hash) all present.

Created high_card practice table, both joined. Loaded via localStorage. casino-start clicked → 2 casino-seat-* seats, dealt cards visible at 38x54, winner line ('Rahul Sharma won 6 coins'), Pot 20, Deal Next Round + Verify this round CTAs, Provably Fair commit shown. No layout breakage.

action_items: Main agent: review the .pc CSS fix in /app/frontend/src/pages/casino-vegas.css (added `display: inline-block; vertical-align: top;`). This was clearly a regression introduced by the palace polish pass — the span element gained no display rule, breaking all face-up card rendering across Rummy AND High Card. Consider also converting <span className='pc'> to a block-level element in PlayingCard.jsx for defense-in-depth.
critical_code_review_comments: PlayingCard.jsx uses <span> as the card root with inline width/height styles. Because <span> is inline by default, the sizing only works when a `.pc-back { display:grid }` rule or an ancestor grid/flex forces layout. All face-up cards depended on the missing display rule. Recommend switching to <span style={{display:'inline-block'}}> or <div> in the JSX to make the component self-contained (currently the CSS fix works but it's fragile — any consumer without casino-vegas.css imported would break).
SIZES table in PlayingCard.jsx has 'sm' at [38,54] but Rummy tray uses 'md' = [46,66] via RCard's size logic (big?lg : small?sm : md). Consider exporting a size prop mapping for consistency.
CasinoPage stale-table fallback for high_card gives no toast (silent redirect). RummyTable does show a toast. Consider parity (already flagged in iteration_28).

rca of the issue: Root cause: The palace polish pass added the .pc-rich class and reshaped the hand tray, but the base `.pc` rule in casino-vegas.css never carried a `display` property. <span> defaults to `display: inline` — which makes CSS `width`/`height` (even when set inline on the element) INEFFECTIVE. `.pc-back` accidentally worked because it explicitly set `display: grid` for centering the R11 mark. Every face-up card (Rummy hand, Discard pile, Wild card, High Card hand + played cards) therefore collapsed to font-metric size (~2x24 px), producing the reported 'tiny/overlapped' hand. Fix (applied): add `display: inline-block; vertical-align: top;` to `.pc` so declared width/height take effect. Reproduction: any Rummy or High Card deal shows the collapsed cards; getComputedStyle('.pc').display returned 'inline' before fix, 'inline-block' after. Mitigation for future: prefer <div> or an explicit display in JSX so the component doesn't rely on a specific CSS rule being loaded.
